title: Shannon-entropy rigidity for discrete shared-covariance location mixtures

entropy_rigidity.energy_floor: K1572 and K1616 give lambda_N^prof-(Lambda_N/2)H(p_N)<=Q_N(Law(X_N)) with Lambda_N=O_g(N).
entropy_rigidity.coefficient: H(p_N)=o(N^3) implies coefficient h_g^prof for the shared-covariance arbitrary-mode translated Gaussian mixture class.
entropy_rigidity.equal_weights: For M_N equal weights, H(p_N)=log M_N; every M_N=exp(o(N^3)), including every polynomial critical or supercritical count, is coefficient-rigid.
entropy_rigidity.comparison: This crosses K1612's Renyi-half component-count boundary only for one common covariance; it does not improve the heterogeneous-covariance theorem.
entropy_rigidity.scope_guard: Shannon entropy does not control label-dependent covariance mixtures, non-Gaussian component shapes, phases, textures, nonstationarity, or unrestricted states.
